notes.title: UI Fix Update
notes.content:
Sorry for the delay in fixing these UI issues. It has been a hard fought challenge, but it is now completetly fixed.

[list]
[*] No more dissapearing buttons.
[*] Shops now work on the first click.
[*] Many small quality of life fixes.
[/list]

Also, many small bugs have also bee adressed. 

I'm currently working on another patch which twaeks some of the balance issues pointed out, and includes some more content in the form of random events/finds. Hopefully, I can give more information on that over the next few weeks.

notes.title: 1.0.4 - Small Fixes
notes.content:
Just a few small fixes...

   * Grabbler enemies no longer cause a crash.
   * Magical items now always get used up.
   * Tiles not longer turn invisible after boss battles.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 - Difficulty Expansion
notes.content:
This small expansion adds three new, craftable maps. These maps are for end-game play and will require heroes of up to level 100 in order to navigate.

Also:

[list]
[*] Rebalanced dungeon room numbers to be less intimidating on easy-medium maps.
[*] Increased the stackable item limit from 99 to 999.
[*] Added 5 potions and meals to players inventories when starting a new game.
[*] Fixed an issue where battles aboard the ships would cause the game to freeze.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
This small update adds another tutorial screen concerning 'levelling' - thanks to Vedicc for the suggestion!

Also:

   * Fixes Autofishing when sad so that they still fish but with lower luck.
   * Stops bookmarks from loosing dungeon data after sleep.
   * Stops the 'thief event' taking gold twice.
   * Lowers the chance of a megaboss spawning in small dungeons.
   * Full moons now increase all party luck slightly.

notes.title: Version 1.0 Uploaded
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35034831/3f18cc2262e841faa207997685416a198f8c2935.png[/img]

Final build uploaded in preparation for launch.

   * New tutorial screens added.
   * Boss enemies scaled down to stop them covering the gold window.
   * Mimic noise lowered.
   * Soul Strike now takes magic.
   * Heroes can no longer lockpick with 0 stamina.
   * Sea tiles now always allow fishing.
   * Bookmarking quest locations no longer causes crash.
   * Bones will now always be fixed when using temple services.
   * Dilemmas call correctly even after lockpicking.
   * Heroes will no longer renegotiate multiple times a day.
   * Healing services completely re-written and re-balanced.
   * Monster quests now vanish after completion.
   * Monster quests now spawn from all their options.

notes.title: 0.61.2 Update (Mood Events)
notes.content:
* Re-introduced mood based events for sadness and anger.

Fixes:

   * Removed repetitive sound on item pickup.
   * Wanderer locations no longer report dungeon rooms incorrectly.
   * Health siphons now draw 100%.
   * Travel events are re-activated.
   * Hero recruitment levels balanced.
   * Event chance increased in humanoid dungeons.
   * Injuries cause anger if not attended.
   * Starting bonus for heroes rebalanced.
   * Heroes leaving due to boredom now report correctly.

notes.title: 0.60.0 Update (Mimics)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35034831/f06308b32d161245455772657a233c9d2be54e34.png[/img]

This update reintroduced Mimics to the game with repaired code. Mimics no longer cause dungeons to become unstable. 

Four mimics have been introduced so far, chest, door, book, and mirror!

Bug Fixes:

   * Dilemmas now always call regardless of enemy type.
   * Bounty hunter event no longer causes crashes.
   * Fixed an issue with enemies not disappearing after they die.
   * Clout can no longer be artificially raised above level.
   * Fixed an issue with enhanced heroes not getting their new powers.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35034831/f88aaf5897d22061de3d36cf13527a2f7bd4dfc4.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.56.6 Update (Steam Achievements)
notes.content:
This update mostly focused on adding Steam Achievements to the game.

   * Eleven visible achievements
   * Thirteen invisible ones related to random quests and the main storyline.

Bugfixes:

   * Fixed humanoids spawning in dungeons.
   * Remove lock-pick button after events.
   * Fixed music stutter issues during battles.
